- Alarm Inhibition: Inhibit Alarm Event
- Alarm Cancellation: Cancel Alarm Event

- Alarm Acknowledgement: Acknowledge Alarm Event
- Alarm Setting: Set Alarm Event
- Alarm Firing (Breath PIP): Firing Breath PIP Event
- Alarm Firing (Leakage): Firing Leakage Event
- Alarm Deactivation: Deactivate Alarm Event

- Steps: Trigger Alarm Event
- Expected: Alarm Occurrence Logged

TC-004: Alarm Reset

- Expected: Alarm Reset Logged

TC-005: Alarm Acknowledgement

- Expected: Alarm Acknowledgement Logged

TC-006: Alarm Setting

- Inputs: Set Alarm Event
- Steps: Trigger Set Alarm Event
- Expected: Alarm Setting Logged

TC-007: Alarm Firing (Breath PIP)

- Inputs: Firing Breath PIP Event
- Steps: Trigger Firing Breath PIP Event
- Expected: Alarm Firing Breath PIP Logged

TC-008: Alarm Firing (Leakage)

TC-009: Alarm Deactivation
- Preconditions: Alarm Firing (Breath PIP) or (Leakage)

- Steps: Trigger Deactivate Alarm Event
- Expected: Alarm Deactivation Logged
